definitions.explanation: Bright, colorful, or eye-catching in appearance. Used for clothing, makeup, decorations, and visual presentation that stands out.
Done in a dramatic, attention-getting way. Used for actions, lifestyles, and events that are showy or grand.

examples.japanese: {派手|はで}な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: She is wearing a brightly colored dress.

examples.japanese: {派手|はで}な⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふさわしく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

examples.english: Some people want a big, showy wedding, while others prefer to keep it quiet.

notes:
Can be positive (eye-catching, glamorous) or negative (garish, too showy) depending on context. In traditional Japanese aesthetics, ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧ is often contrasted with ⟦{渋|しぶ}い→渋い：06820_shibui⟧ (refined, understated), and being too ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧ can be seen as lacking taste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {派手|はで}な⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧: flashy attire
- {派手|はで}な⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: bright color
- {派手|はで}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: extravagant lifestyle
- {派手|はで}に⟦{散財|さんざい}→散財：09233_sanzai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to spend lavishly
- {派手|はで}に⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fail spectacularly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地味|じみ}→地味：01573_jimi⟧な: plain; subdued — the direct opposite of {派手|はで}な
- ⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な: gorgeous; brilliant — more positive, emphasizing beauty and elegance
- けばけばしい: gaudy; garish — always negative, implying vulgarly flashy
